label: Scene Template: Hero Stat
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: one number carries the scene. Set sunburst:true for the celebration variant (pale rotating rays + confetti behind the numeral) on the film's payoff figure. Locked composition -- left text column (kicker + masked headline + supporting), oversized count-up numeral right-of-center with a ghost echo, item tags along the lower third, wordmark + scene index anchors. Codegen fills slots only; bespoke additions go in the .st-overlay region.

headline.label: Headline; use | for the line break

sunburst.label: Celebration variant: pale rotating rays + a confetti burst behind the numeral (for the film's payoff number)
